entries.headline: Cash beat every researched entry; the open PLTR winner remains bracketed, concentrated, and near its target.
thoughts: Late-Friday risk-on tape did not justify chasing. QNST and TEAM were far outside the frozen no-chase rule, while XLK, XLV, and TTD produced no valid fresh trigger.

PLTR remains the only open position. The original thesis is intact, but current reward remaining versus stop distance is poor and the book has one dominant high-beta factor exposure with no offsetting sleeve.
NO_TRADE is a decision, not inactivity. Cash won because no candidate passed evidence, entry, liquidity, and reward-to-risk gates.

The owner set paper risk appetite to 7/10 and authorized a 20% aggregate managed-risk ceiling with no separate aggressive-position cap. That is preference, not proven edge; per-trade aggressive sizing stays locked behind a 20-trade, +0.30R evidence gate.

strategies.name: Day-two post-gap consolidation
strategies.rules: Verified catalyst, completed 15-minute trigger, frozen artifact, and no chase beyond 0.32 ATR.

strategies.name: Negative-catalyst oversold reclaim
strategies.rules: Equity-first; require a completed reclaim of frozen structure and VWAP after at least a 3 ATR event move.

strategies.name: Liquid index or sector downside continuation
strategies.rules: Ten observations are required before any separate execution review; shadows never authorize orders.

positions.thesis: Earnings reacceleration and government backlog supported the original continuation thesis.
positions.risk: Original bracket unchanged. Position is near target, but mark-to-target reward is small relative to mark-to-stop risk; weekend and CPI gap risk remain.

pnl.note: Realized and unrealized results are separated. Open marks can reverse and are not booked profit.

candidate_review.reason: Catalyst move was an extreme multi-ATR chase; a prospective next-session consolidation shadow was registered instead.
Entry was a multi-ATR chase and the observed equity spread failed the liquidity standard.
The prior shadow stopped; no same-session retry without a new prospective setup.
The frozen support entry did not trade.
Neither the bullish reclaim nor bearish breakdown completed.

public_entry_reviews.result: Final privacy and statistical review found no remaining issues and approved publication.
Final adversarial review confirmed the original critique was incorporated and approved the first public entry.

fable.result: Six journal-hygiene fixes were applied before the private journal was persisted: symmetric TTD shadows, QNST blocked-chase shadow, realistic WMT fill sensitivity, bounded source claims, corrected expectancy denominators, and a prospective PLTR exit counterfactual.

grok.result: Grok accepted NO_TRADE but rejected public dollar and quantity leakage, the three-trade size unlock, the 0.50 ATR aggressive chase allowance, and any claim that 7/10 risk is supported by proven edge.

changes_after_grok: Public output now excludes quantities, execution prices, account identifiers, balances, buying power, net liquidation value, and dollar P&L.
Aggressive per-trade sizing now requires 20 eligible closed aggressive trades averaging at least +0.30R.
Aggressive no-chase distance is restored to 0.32 ATR.
Owner risk appetite is labeled as preference rather than evidence of edge.

limitations: Paper trading only; no live-money inference.
Equity microstructure uses single-venue IEX data, not consolidated SIP or NBBO.
Option quotes are indicative; wide exits are marked fill-model-dependent.
Open-position P&L is marked, not realized.
Shadows are research records and never authorize orders.
